component.summary: ffmpeg-video-audio-converter Video Converter, an open-source multimedia converter

description.p: ffmpeg-video-audio-converter is a GUI for FFmpeg, a powerful media converter. FFmpeg can read audio and video files in various formats and convert them into other formats. ffmpeg-video-audio-converter features an intuitive graphical interface and a rich set of presets to help you convert media files within a few clicks. Advanced users can also adjust conversion parameters in detail.
